research_question: Does score-error-weighted RARS outperform an ordinary storage-matched residual-PCA sidecar on an independent corpus and query set?

embedding.model_snapshot_policy: save one local Stage-1 snapshot and hash every snapshot file before test access; all later query encoding must load that snapshot
embedding.document_text: title newline text when title is non-empty, otherwise text
embedding.query_text: raw BEIR query text without an added instruction prefix

query_usage.fit_and_validation_source: BEIR NQ train split query IDs and texts
query_usage.test_source: all official BEIR NQ test query IDs remaining after identity-only prior-overlap exclusions
query_usage.test_qrels_access_gate: method artifacts, selected configs, evaluator, protocol, and pre-qrels manifest must be committed and hashed first
query_usage.prior_overlap_rule: exclude exact query-ID overlap only within the same declared dataset namespace, or exact normalized-query-text overlap across datasets; freeze exclusions before retrieval outcomes
query_usage.query_text_normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse all whitespace runs, and strip

pca.basis: top right singular vectors of an unweighted document-residual sample
pca.sampling: uniform document rows without replacement, then residual covariance eigendecomposition

rars.sampling: draw document rows with replacement in proportion to summed absolute fit-query candidate score error; aggregate duplicate draw counts before residual covariance eigendecomposition

validation.selection_signal: exact Top-10 candidate overlap within the frozen Top-100 candidate pool
validation.ranking_tie_rule: stable descending score order preserving frozen candidate order
validation.selection_rule: for each sidecar, choose the smallest Top-B retaining at least 90% of its maximum validation overlap gain; within that Top-B choose highest overlap; ties by smaller absolute alpha then smaller numeric alpha

evaluation.primary_support_rule: two-sided 95% paired-bootstrap confidence-interval lower bound is greater than zero

freeze_order: verify source archive MD5 without opening test qrels
build full-corpus embeddings and frozen IVF-PQ index
derive train and validation partitions from NQ train query IDs
fit PCA and RARS bases and encode both sidecars
select PCA and RARS alpha and Top-B using validation proxy only
freeze selected configs, evaluator, hashes, and pre-qrels manifest in Git
only then access test qrels for identity and coverage audits
freeze the eligible test-query manifest and qrels hash in a second Git commit
run Base, PCA, and RARS once, bootstrap once, write all outputs, and stop
forbidden_before_test_qrels_gate: test-informed changes to basis, alpha, Top-B, rank, nprobe, candidate depth, metric, or evaluator

decision_rules.positive: claim qualified independent RARS advantage over storage-matched PCA
decision_rules.null: claim no established RARS advantage; emphasize residual-sidecar behavior and uncertainty
decision_rules.negative: report that ordinary residual PCA generalizes better under this setting

resource_estimates.note: Estimates use the published approximately 2.68M-document corpus size. Document vectors are stored as float16 and converted to float32 for Faiss and residual computations. Record exact bytes after preparation. Runtime and operational batch sizes are hardware-dependent.
